fullContentHtml:
Short Information :  Join Indian Army (Govt. Of India) has release notification for the NCC Special Entry 58th October 2025 Batch SSC Recruitment on the official website of Indian Army. Any candidate who is interested to fill this form, they should check eligibility, age limit & must read the Full Notification Before applying for the Army NCC Special Entry Scheme Recruitment 2025. Those Candidates Are Interested in the following recruitment can apply online from the link given below.

Join Indian Army (Govt. Of India)

Indian Army NCC Special Entry Scheme 58th Course Recruitment 2025

Important Dates

  • Application Start Date : 14 February 2025
  • Last Date : 15 March 2025
  • Course Start On : October 2025

Application Fee

  • General, EWS, OBC : 0/-
  • SC, ST, Female : 0/-
  • No Application Fee

Indian Army NCC Special Entry Scheme 58th Course Notification 2025 : Age Limit

  • Age Limit As On 01 January 2025
  • Minimum Age : 19 Years
  • Maximum Age : 25 Years
  • Born not earlier than 02 July 2000 and not later than 01 July 2006, both dates Inclusive
  • Age Relaxation as per Indian Army NCC Special Entry Scheme 58th Course Recruitment Rules.
  • Use Tool –

Indian Army NCC Special Entry Scheme 58th Course 2025 : Vacancy Details

Total Posts : 76

Trade Name Total Post
NCC Men 63
NCC Women 05

Indian Army NCC Special Entry Scheme 58th Course Bharti 2025 : Educational Qualification

  • For NCC–C Certificate Holder : Candidates who have Bachelor Degree in Any Stream with 50% Marks From a recognized University in India will be eligible for this recruitment or its equivalent.
  • Candidates must have Min 2 Year NCC Certificate.
  • Ward Of Battle Casualties : Candidates who have Bachelor Degree in Any Stream with 50% Marks From a recognized University in India will be eligible for this recruitment or its equivalent.
  • For More Details regarding eligibility criteria, Candidates are must advised to read the official notification carefully before applying for this recruitment.

Indian Army NCC Special Entry Scheme 58th Course Job 2025 : Physical Standard Details

  • Height Men – 157.5 cms
  • Height Women – 152 cms
  • Running – 2.4 km Run in 15 Minutes

Indian Army NCC Special Entry Scheme 58th Course Online Form 2025 : How To Apply

  • Candidates can apply through link https://joinindianarmy.nic.in or provided below in link section or they can also apply through official site of the Indian Army before Last Date.
  • You Can Check other Sarkari Result 2025 Notification Here – Check Now.
  • For all the interested and eligible candidates who want to apply for Indian Army NCC Special Entry Scheme 58th Course recruitment can read all the information related to the recruitment is given below and the link to apply is given in the Important Link section below.
